# port_llm_provider (Resource)

# LLM Provider resource

Register or update an LLM provider configuration for Port AI.

See the [LLM provider management documentation](https://docs.port.io/port-ai/llm-providers-management/overview/) and the [Create or connect an LLM provider API](https://docs.port.io/api-reference/create-or-connect-an-llm-provider/).

## Example: Anthropic-compatible provider

```hcl
resource "port_llm_provider" "anthropic_compatible" {
  provider_type         = "anthropic-compatible"
  enabled             = true
  validate_connection = true

  anthropic_compatible {
    base_url            = "https://litellm.corp.example.com/anthropic"
    api_key_secret_name = "LITELLM_API_KEY"

    models {
      name           = "claude-sonnet"
      display_name   = "Claude Sonnet"
      context_window = 200000

      supported_features {
        caching                  = true
        native_structured_output = false
      }
    }
  }
}

```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_type` (String) The LLM provider type. Supported values include `openai`, `anthropic`, `azure-openai`, `azure-anthropic`, `openai-compatible`, `anthropic-compatible`, `vertex-gemini`, and `vertex-anthropic`.

### Optional

- `anthropic_compatible` (Block, Optional) Configuration for an Anthropic Messages API-compatible endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--anthropic_compatible))
- `api_key` (Block, Optional) Simple API key configuration for built-in providers such as `openai` and `anthropic`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--api_key))
- `azure_anthropic` (Block, Optional) Configuration for Claude models hosted in Azure. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--azure_anthropic))
- `azure_openai` (Block, Optional) Configuration for OpenAI models hosted in Azure. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--azure_openai))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this provider is enabled.
- `openai_compatible` (Block, Optional) Configuration for an OpenAI chat completions-compatible endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--openai_compatible))
- `validate_connection` (Boolean) When true, Port validates the provider configuration on create and update.
- `vertex_anthropic` (Block, Optional) Configuration for Claude models hosted on Google Vertex AI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vertex_anthropic))
- `vertex_gemini` (Block, Optional) Configuration for Gemini models hosted on Google Vertex AI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vertex_gemini))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The LLM provider type (same as `provider_type`).

<a id="nestedblock--anthropic_compatible"></a>
### Nested Schema for `anthropic_compatible`

Required:

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Anthropic Messages API endpoint — the prefix before `/messages`.

Optional:

- `api_key_secret_name` (String) Name of a Port secret holding the key sent as the `x-api-key` header.
- `auth_token_secret_name` (String) Name of a Port secret holding the token sent as the `Authorization: Bearer` header.
- `custom_headers` (Map of String) Optional HTTP headers to add to every request to this provider.
- `models` (Block List) Model catalog for this provider. Each `name` is the model id used in the `model` field on invocations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--anthropic_compatible--models))

<a id="nestedblock--anthropic_compatible--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `anthropic_compatible.models`

Required:

- `name` (String) Model identifier as exposed by the provider.

Optional:

- `context_window` (Number)
- `display_name` (String)
- `supported_features` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--anthropic_compatible--models--supported_features))

<a id="nestedblock--anthropic_compatible--models--supported_features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `anthropic_compatible.models.supported_features`

Optional:

- `adaptive_thinking` (Boolean)
- `caching` (Boolean)
- `extended_thinking` (Boolean)
- `guardrails` (Boolean)
- `native_structured_output` (Boolean) Whether this model accepts Anthropic's native `output_format` for structured output. Leave unset to let Port infer it from the model identifier; set to `false` when the identifier resembles a Claude model but the endpoint does not support `output_format`.
- `reasoning_effort` (Boolean)
- `supports_structured_outputs` (Boolean)
- `temperature` (Boolean)
